selfVerdict: Strong, distinctive and honest, but not yet top-of-class on the plate itself. It reads as a printed star-atlas plate rather than a dashboard: the plate with its 60 night-meridians, graticule crosses and the apricot 'Late Leg Day' constellation is the dominant object and also the proof (a real-form sentence with n and confidence, 'association, not cause' printed beside it). The warm-night ground and apricot-only colour separate it from the navy/neon cluster and from AfterShift, the badge is framed and unmistakable beside a white QR tile, and the privacy ledger as the opener plus the cropped real Correlations screenshot make the second screen a different page order, not the template. What is weaker: the plate band is only about 190px tall, so the constellation reads closer to a zigzag line chart than a figure; star-on-dark still sits near the generic 'space' theme and survives only because of the restraint (no glow, no twinkle) and the printed caveat; the first viewport is dense (key, legend, sentence, buttons) with 13px SVG labels; Bodoni on a dark ground edges toward luxury; below the plate the page is text-heavy until the screenshots and mini-plates arrive. If the owner wants it stronger, the next step is a taller plate with a branching constellation figure. Keep as a contender.
